profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Raytheon Technologies
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Active TS/SCI Clearance
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience in web development, mobile applications, embedded systems, game development, and desktop applications. Worked in multiple industries including small satellite, federal contracting, and B2B/Big Data. Development experience in multiple languages with most experience in Java. Knowledge of database architecture and SQL. Work experience with both back end and front end development.

Objective: Further my skills as a Software Engineer with interest in Software Development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Active TS/SCI Clearance
positions.description:
Provided full-stack software engineering support for enterprise-level data distribution system
Scrum Master
- Performed role of Scrum Master for two teams simultaneously in addition to regular job role
- Facilitated Agile meetings including daily stand-ups, sprint plannings, backlog groomings, etc...
- Assisted in Contractor Level of Effort estimates for proposals and future work
- Performed baseline configuration management for both Agile teams
- Created integration test framework and developed team coding standards to increase code reliability
- Utilized Atlassian Tool Suite to administer Agile process and manage software baseline
Software Development
- Utilized the Java Secure Socket Extension to implement NIO socket channels with TLS
- Designed and implemented system monitoring user interface utilizing Splunk Enterprise and ITSI
- Developed AI/ML algorithm to detect deviation of data volumes from expected range
- Utilized Spring Framework for dependency injection
- Provided hands-on Splunk UI training for tier1, tier 2, and mission control support groups
- Assisted in the creation of acceptance criteria for engineering requirements
- Provided O&M support by troubleshooting software problems and performing sysadmin support
- Conducted intensive performance testing of various hardware sets in different environments and presented results in front of program leadership and government representatives
- Supported migration of development environment from local workstations to AWS EC2 instances
- Assisted in architectural design for Kubernetes-managed containerized deployment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided technical and development support for web-based supply chain management system utilizing agile methodologies, JSP/Java
-Collaborated with customers to determine requirements for functionality of new and existing features
-Designed and developed code for implementation of feature changes and additions
--Mapped existing classes to DB2 database using object relational mapping conforming to existing Spring MVC framework
--Improved speed of database replication tool by over 75%
--Developed user control and servlet utilizing existing Apache Struts MVC framework
-Developed JUnit and Integration tests to verify proper functionality of additional features
- Designed and implemented continuous end-to-end testing of our European production servers

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Assisted in porting of satellite flight software from VxWorks to Linux, C++
Developed platform-independent script to automate testing of satellite flight software against coding standards, Python
-Modified tool chain to generate information of build process
-Arranged meeting to demonstrate use of static analysis tool for team development
Implemented script to automate build and merge of specific Visual Studios projects into source control, Python
-Refactored script to work for any Visual Studio project
-Suggested changes to improve configuration files and maximize reusability in the future

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Provided software support for an optimal budgeting solution application used by the Department of Defense, VB.net
-Created a user interface implementing a Model View Controller (MVC) software pattern
-Debugged over 50% of total number of software issues
Assisted in early design architecture of system that provides tracing information for cyber security damage assessment, Java
-Constructed new data objects that were mapped to a MySQL database using object relational mapping
-Developed library base classes and refactored components into an abstract class using generics
Developed utility functions for Excel and Access with macros, VBA

Technology used: Ubuntu, Apache Tomcat, MySQL, Hibernate, Java, JSP, JSTL, JSON, AJAX, Javascript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL, C3P0, Git.
Compatible web browsers: Google Chrome v39, Mozilla Firefox v34, Internet Explorer v11
